## Final checklist

- [ ] Branch name follows `<type>/<area>/<optional-issue-number>-<description>`

- [ ] PR is linked to an issue, unless this is a tiny maintenance PR

- [ ] Tests pass locally, or reason is explained
- [ ] No unrelated formatting changes
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, generated files, or IDE junk committed
